summary: Nine days to Expo (Nov 4). Slot picker is merged and the pricing page and one-pager are final. Coastal, a design partner, has had a login outage since this morning and its CEO is questioning readiness. Pinecrest live demo is at 3pm. Load testing and booth prep continue.

items.text: No Coastal user can log in since this morning because of a redirect loop after SSO. Dispatchers are back on spreadsheets. TW-144 is owned by Leila and due today.
Grace at Coastal is escalating, and her CEO is asking whether Smart Slots is ready for real use. Jordan's call with Grace (TW-145) is due today.
Design partner onboarding: Valley's setup started today and its first week of bookings is imported. Coastal had twelve staging users before the outage. TW-121 is due Oct 30.
Slot picker PR #241 merged after Sam's approval (TW-141 and TW-117 done). Demo screen 3 no longer waits on it.
Demo run time is down to 2:10, from 2:40 yesterday. Sam wanted it under two minutes. TW-119 is still in progress, due Oct 30.
Booth ships Thursday, so printed material must be final by Wednesday. The one-pager is final in Figma, and TW-150 (print files) is due Oct 28. Pricing page (TW-125) is done.
The scoring API passed a 5x load test. Nina's 10x test (TW-143) is scheduled for Wednesday and due Oct 30. TW-115 is due Oct 28.
Arjun created two Expo tasks for himself: rate limits for booth traffic (TW-146, due Oct 30) and a demo environment with Coastal's anonymized data (TW-147, due Oct 29).
Arjun created TW-148 for Nina: cache slot scores so the booth demo stays fast on booth Wi-Fi. Due Oct 30.
Leila created TW-149, a full-screen booth tablet mode for the slot picker, due Oct 29. Error and empty states (TW-135) are in progress, also due Oct 29.
Ranking for Coastal's early-morning docks looks better. TW-138 is still in progress, due Oct 28.
Harbor Foods (38% of revenue) renews Oct 30. QBR notes were sent to Dana, the 4-week trend was added to its report, and sync alerts now go to its ops channel.
Ridgeline (yellow health, 22% of revenue) renews Nov 20 after repeated double-bookings. The duplicates fix is live. Renewal prep TW-113 is due Nov 13.
Pinecrest sees the live demo today at 3pm. A third signed design partner is needed by launch. TW-126 is due Oct 30.
Maya's booth demo script (TW-120) is in progress, due Oct 30.
Smart Slots remains the company focus until Expo on Nov 4. Sync work was deferred unless sync worsened.
